control_plane_hardening_items_recorded_n: core-lane.yml:163-165 gates the audit job on `needs.team.result == 'success'`, i.e. on the producer agent's exit code. Measured consequence this round: 3 of 14 dispatches died at the quantum and all 3 skipped the audit, so a delivered tree can never be promoted. Intended upstream fix for the control-plane maintainer: gate the audit job on `if: always() && needs.team.outputs.deliverable_present == 'true'` (or on the persist step having produced a commit), never on the producer step's exit code alone.

the producer step's exit code is invisible: job logs are HTTP 403 unauthenticated, so a zero-delta producer and a post-delivery producer are indistinguishable from outside. Intended upstream fix: surface run-ox-with-retry.sh's rc as a step output and echo it, so the distinction is machine-readable without logs.
